papers.title: Quantitative texture prediction of epitaxial columnar grains in additive manufacturing using selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering and Materials Science, University of Pittsburgh, Pittsburgh, PA 15261, United States

corresponding_authors.name: Albert C. To
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering and Materials Science, University of Pittsburgh, Pittsburgh, PA 15261, United States

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究激光熔化增材制造中的晶粒取向预测，与生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力屏蔽或力学性能无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not cover porous implant design, stress shielding, mechanical testing, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 预测选区激光熔化中柱状晶的晶体学织构
summary_zh.method: 耦合热流体和元胞自动机模型模拟晶粒生长
summary_zh.result: 成功预测了不同工艺参数下的织构演变
summary_zh.validation: 与实验EBSD表征结果对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To predict crystallographic texture of epitaxial columnar grains in selective laser melting for process optimization.
summary_en.method: A coupled thermal-fluid and cellular automaton model was developed to simulate grain growth during solidification.
summary_en.result: The model accurately predicted texture variations as a function of laser power and scan speed.
summary_en.validation: Predictions were validated against experimental electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) measurements.

papers.title: Processing of Ti-5553 with improved mechanical properties via an in-situ heat treatment combining selective laser melting and substrate plate heating
papers.first_author_affiliation: IFW Dresden, Institute for Complex Materials, D-01069 Dresden, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: H. Schwab
corresponding_authors.affiliation: IFW Dresden, Institute for Complex Materials, D-01069 Dresden, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于Ti-5553合金的SLM工艺优化，未涉及生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue performance, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善Ti-5553合金的SLM成形力学性能
summary_zh.method: 利用基板加热实现SLM原位热处理
summary_zh.result: 成功提升了合金的强度与塑性
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸和硬度测试验证力学性能

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the mechanical properties of Ti-5553 alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: An in-situ heat treatment was implemented via substrate plate heating during the SLM process.
summary_en.result: The alloy exhibited improved strength and ductility compared to standard SLM processing.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through tensile testing and hardness measurements.

papers.title: Can Surgeons Reduce the Risk for Dislocation After Primary Total Hip Arthroplasty Performed Using the Posterolateral Approach?
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Copenhagen University Hospital Hvidovre, Copenhagen, Denmark

corresponding_authors.name: Kirill Gromov
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Copenhagen University Hospital Hvidovre, Copenhagen, Denmark

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注THA术后脱位的临床风险因素，不涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或骨-植入物界面的力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical study on dislocation risk factors after THA, with no biomechanical modeling, no implant stress shielding analysis, and no finite element simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨外科医生能否通过手术技术降低THA术后脱位风险。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析采用后外侧入路的THA病例，统计脱位率及相关因素。
summary_zh.result: 特定手术技术（如修复外旋肌群）可显著降低脱位风险。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床病例数据的统计学分析验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether specific surgical techniques can reduce the risk of dislocation after primary total hip arthroplasty via posterolateral approach.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of a large cohort of THA patients with posterolateral approach, evaluating dislocation rates and associated surgical factors.
summary_en.result: Repair of the external rotators and capsule significantly reduced the dislocation rate.
summary_en.validation: Clinical data from 1,268 primary THA cases with statistical analysis of risk factors.

papers.title: Clinical and Radiographic Outcomes of Total Hip Arthroplasty With a Specific Liner in Small Asian Patients: Influence of Patient-Related, Implant-Related, and Surgical Factors on Femoral Head Penetration
papers.first_author_affiliation: Sensory & Motor System Medicine, Faculty of Medicine, The University of Tokyo, Tokyo, Japan; Division of Science for Joint Reconstruction, Graduate School of Medicine, The University of Tokyo, Tokyo, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Toru Moro
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Sensory & Motor System Medicine, Faculty of Medicine, The University of Tokyo, Tokyo, Japan; Division of Science for Joint Reconstruction, Graduate School of Medicine, The University of Tokyo, Tokyo, Japan

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床回顾性研究，关注小体型亚洲患者的THA术后股骨头穿透率，不涉及任何生物力学建模或应力分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper provides clinical wear outcomes but contains no FE modeling, no stress/strain analysis in Gruen zones, no micromotion or contact mechanics, and no comparison of intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估小体型亚洲患者使用特定内衬的THA术后股骨头穿透情况及相关影响因素
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析临床及影像学数据，统计患者、假体及手术因素对穿透率的影响
summary_zh.result: 发现年轻、男性、大股骨头直径与高穿透率显著相关，内衬设计影响较小

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate femoral head penetration and its influencing factors in small Asian patients after THA with a specific liner design.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of clinical and radiographic outcomes, correlating patient, implant, and surgical variables with penetration rates.
summary_en.result: Younger age, male gender, and larger femoral head diameter were significantly associated with higher penetration; liner design had minimal effect.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up and radiographic measurement of wear.
